name: Telemetry: Tool Latency
description: Scores the worst per-tool mean latency against the per-tool budget. A null map skips; an empty map records no tool calls and is not applicable. Any negative or non-finite latency returns an error. Measured zero latency is valid.

expectedInputs.description: AgenticTelemetry.ToolLatencyMs: null when not tracked, empty when no tool calls were recorded, otherwise finite non-negative means keyed by tool name.
